chocolate.hook: A commerce case study where branding, customer flow, and backend operations all matter at the same time.
chocolate.impactOne: Shows the difference between a styled storefront and a real purchase system.
chocolate.impactTwo: Demonstrates brand-led UI decisions without losing backend rigor.

petnest.hook: A trust-centered adoption platform that balances public discovery with operational moderation.
petnest.impactOne: Shows how a portfolio app can model trust, moderation, and user workflow complexity.
petnest.impactTwo: Adds strong TypeScript credibility across frontend and backend.

orchidcare.hook: A practical plant-care product where searchable data, care metadata, and a calm browsing experience work together.
orchidcare.impactOne: Shows care-specific product thinking instead of another general dashboard.
orchidcare.impactTwo: Demonstrates how frontend filters connect to validated backend query handling.

english4u.hook: A learning platform positioned like a real digital product, not just a lessons demo.
english4u.impactOne: Connects product thinking to a realistic self-paced education experience.
english4u.impactTwo: Shows how auth, progress, content, and admin structure work together.

paytrack.hook: A calm personal finance assistant that turns forgotten recurring payments into a clear, mobile-first product flow.
paytrack.impactOne: Shows full-stack product thinking around a real everyday money problem.
paytrack.impactTwo: Demonstrates secure organization of sensitive-adjacent payment information without storing full card data.

ai-comparator.hook: A focused comparison tool that turns a course assignment into a clean product workflow for evaluating AI models.
ai-comparator.impactOne: Shows practical React routing, API integration, and state coordination without overengineering.
ai-comparator.impactTwo: Makes comparison logic visible through a real two-model workflow instead of a static table.

brickdrop.hook: A compact game build that proves strong frontend logic can be immediately playable.
brickdrop.impactOne: Adds immediate interactivity to the portfolio instead of only static product case studies.
brickdrop.impactTwo: Shows frontend engineering skill through mechanics, timing, and state transitions.

sea-battle.hook: A visually ambitious browser game that combines interface systems, motion, and AI-driven play.
sea-battle.impactOne: Expands the portfolio beyond product apps into richer interaction design.
sea-battle.impactTwo: Shows a stronger UI system with motion, modal states, and gameplay feedback.

About.introduction: Junior Full-Stack Developer building responsive, user-focused web applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MySQL. Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end projects, from mobile-first interfaces to REST APIs, authentication, payment workflows and database integration. A background in Java and Spring Boot, UX/UI and technical teaching brings a thoughtful approach to usability, problem-solving, collaboration and commitment to continuous learning.
